title: Repoise benchmark trial grading record (version 1)
description: One grading record per trial (trials/<id>/grading.json). Written by the grading engine (source 'engine') or by an operator for declared manual methods (humanRubric / modelJudge). Engine-written records carry source 'engine'; operator records are validated on read and kept unchanged when valid. Grading is data-only: transcript and repository content are never executed.

status.description: pass/fail are grading outcomes; not_graded covers undeclared evaluators, pending manual review, censored (timed-out) trials and infra failures; evaluator_error means the grading engine itself failed.

method.description: The grading method actually applied (or the declared one when pending); 'none' when the task declared no evaluator.

reason.description: Human-readable reason; required non-empty for valid manual pass/fail records.

artifact.description: Artifact file name; null for answer-scope checks.

note.description: The check's assertion note; null when the suite declared none.

source.description: Provenance marker for engine-written records; operator-written manual records omit it.
